changesSurface.title: Changes

headLead.onBranch: Compared with the last commit {{id}} “{{summary}}” on {{branch}}. The saved state is counted.
headLead.detached: Compared with the last commit {{id}} “{{summary}}” (detached). The saved state is counted.

changesSurface.noProjectWhy: Open a project, then Technical shows here what differs from the original.

base.empty: Everything as in the base ROM.
base.assignHint: You assign the base ROM in Technical › Publish.
base.lead: Compared with the base ROM {{label}}. The saved state is counted.
base.unbuilt: Not built yet: {{folders}}. The comparison is faster after the next build.

head.empty: Nothing changed since the last commit.
head.noRepo: This project is not in any Git repository.
head.noRepoHint: Setting up Git creates a local repository; local or private only, Gen4 Studio uploads nothing.
head.noCommitNote: No commit yet: there is nothing to compare.

saved.lead: What is unsaved and differs from the saved state.

entityDiff.noPlace: This kind has no place in the app.
entityDiff.choose: Choose an entry in the list, then what changed is shown here.

publishSurface.title: Publish
publishSurface.lead: A patch hands on your changes without the ROM: anyone with the same base ROM applies it with Rom Patcher JS or xdelta3.
publishSurface.noProjectWhy: Open a project, then publish it here.
publishSurface.baseText: A patch describes the difference to your base ROM. The ROM stays outside the project; Gen4 Studio only remembers where it is.
publishSurface.noBaseAssigned: No base ROM is assigned to this project.
publishSurface.publishText: The wizard asks for the version and change notes, builds the ROM and writes the patch with a companion file to the location you choose.

assignDialog.title: Assign base ROM?
assignDialog.writes: Writes the base mark .g4/base.json into the project.

textProjectSurface.title: Text project
textProjectSurface.agentSettingUp: Being set up by an agent …
textProjectSurface.setUpLead: The project is in the DSPRE layout. As a text project, every entry gets a readable file under data/, ready for Git; DSPRE keeps opening the folder.
textProjectSurface.noProjectWhy: Open a project, then Technical shows its text project here.
textProjectSurface.olderLead: Text project, schema version {{schema}}: older than this version of Gen4 Studio. Until it is upgraded, it can only be read.
textProjectSurface.newer: The text project comes from a newer version of Gen4 Studio (schema version {{schema}}).
textProjectSurface.worldChanged: This world map was changed outside Studio.
textProjectSurface.discards: “{{take}}” discards the unsaved changes to this entry.

technikArea.title: Technical

previewSource.standard: Map picture of the start town

technikArea.emulatorText: Studio runs built ROMs in this emulator. The choice applies to all projects.

project.title: Project
project.noProjectWhy: Open a project, then Technical shows its preview picture here.

preview.heading: Preview picture
preview.hintStartTown: Without a picture of its own, Start shows the map picture of the start town.
preview.hintTown: Without a picture of its own, Start shows the map picture of {{town}}.

build.title: Check and build
build.noProjectWhy: Open a project, then Technical checks and builds it here.
build.rebuildHint: Deletes the build state and builds everything anew
build.browserMode: In browser mode the ROM is only built
build.noBuildYet: No build in this session yet.
build.noProblems: No problems. Errors and warnings from saving and building end up here.
build.checking: Checking the project … The findings of the checks appear here as soon as they are done.
build.noProblemsChecks: No problems. The checks run after every change; errors and warnings from saving and building end up here.

baseline.note: Hides all current warnings and infos; errors stay visible.
baseline.title: Adopt the baseline?
baseline.description_one: {{count}} warning or info will be hidden. If a spot changes, it reports again; you bring it back under “Report again…”.
baseline.description_other: {{count}} warnings and infos will be hidden. If a spot changes, it reports again; you bring it back under “Report again…”.

patches.title: Patches
patches.noProjectWhy: Open a project, then Technical shows its patches here.
patches.heading: Dynamic headers
patches.text: New places need headers of their own. The patch moves the headers into one file per header and changes bytes in the game code (arm9.bin) to do so. DSPRE knows it.
patches.brokenText: The patch calls the wrong function in the game code: the game stays black after the intro. The repair changes 4 bytes in arm9.bin.
patches.dialogDescription: The patch changes bytes in the game code (arm9.bin); the backup arm9.bin.backup is created. Unsaved changes to areas and rooms stay unsaved.

tools.title: Tools

apiculaNote.unbekannt: Shows up with the first map picture.
apiculaNote.fehlt: Without apicula there are no map pictures and 3D models.

tools.lspNoteNotStarted: Starts as soon as the Script panel has been shown once.
tools.apiculaText: Turns the game's maps into 3D models and map pictures.
tools.lspText: Language service for scripts: completion and diagnostics in the editor.
tools.clearWorldText: Turns the world into an empty region with a start town. You get the world back with ⌘Z.
